task: Develop a unified deep learning framework that takes protein sequences, nucleic acid sequences, and small molecule structures as input, and outputs accurate 3D structures of biomolecular complexes using a diffusion-based architecture to predict interactions across diverse biological molecules.

data.name: 2l3r_protein.pdb
data.description: This file contains the full-atom protein component of the UHRF1 tandem Tudor domain–histone H3 peptide complex (PDB ID: 2L3R, first NMR model, chain A). It comprises 161 residues and 2,591 ATOM records including hydrogens. The 161 CA coordinates can be extracted for protein backbone RMSD calculations and structural overlay visualizations. See https://www.rcsb.org/structure/2L3R for the source structure.

data.name: 2l3r_ligand.sdf
data.description: This file contains the experimental conformation of the histone H3-derived peptide bound to the UHRF1 tandem Tudor domains in PDB entry 2L3R, including trimethyllysine. It is stored in Structure-Data File (SDF) format with 194 atoms including hydrogens. Its 90 non-hydrogen atoms correspond to chain B of the first NMR model. The file provides the reference peptide coordinates and bond connectivity for pose comparisons with the supplied protein structure. See https://www.rcsb.org/structure/2L3R for the source complex.
